$comment: Checked-in record of what the pre-provisioned Home Assistant image ships (TAP-6483).
Vendored components no longer self-update, so without this file component drift
becomes invisible rather than merely slow. Enforced by
Change a version here AND in domains/core-platform/home-assistant/Dockerfile, or CI fails.

custom_components.name: powercalc
custom_components.note: Upstream tarball ships a placeholder manifest version (0.1.1); the build stamps the release tag in, as HACS does at install time.

custom_components.name: homeiq
custom_components.note: Version tracks custom_components/homeiq/manifest.json in this repo.

zha_quirks.name: aqara_fp1e.py
zha_quirks.note: A ZHA quirk, NOT a custom_component. zhaquirks.setup() reads only the directory named by zha.custom_quirks_path, which the seeded configuration.yaml sets.
